workflow.description: Use BLDS agent-readable contracts to inspect BottomBar semantics before an accessibility-large remediation.

baseline.observed: The current consumer uses a fixed 62px BottomBar and needs an app-local adapter for the action semantic label API.
baseline.limit: This pilot measures contract retrieval and unsupported-state safety; it does not claim consumer runtime performance or a completed accessibility remediation.

maintenance.owner: BLDS Engineering Team / Design System Engineer
maintenance.manual_lookup_comparison: A repository-wide manual lookup baseline was not measured in this cycle; no productivity claim is made.
triggers: Any semantic contract, token, state applicability, public API, example, test, or design evidence change.
Any consumer reports a mismatch between agent guidance and implemented behavior.
Before enabling a new remote adapter or adding a component to the reviewed Figma set.
